tau.interpretation: Numerical decision floor, not confidence interval, noninferiority test or population uncertainty.

selection_effects.comparison_rule: Negative delta is lower NLL; improvement must be strictly below -tau. Inside-floor positive differences are failed improvement gates, not established harm.

body_branch_accounting.finding: On this recorded body step the fixed-event fit response decreases and closely agrees with its derivative-dot-step; the measured hard-minus-fixed event-path counterfactual contrast offsets that decrease and reverses the hard fit sign. This supports a local event-associated finite-step difference under the registered intervention, not a unique event-credit/reset mechanism, causal global bottleneck, or long-run root cause.

scale_0p1_descriptive_only.interpretation: No endpoint substitution. The scale0.1 control has no separately measured FP32 realized body norm; its nominal scaled Taylor comparison is descriptive.

learning_operator_accounting.interpretation: All directional summaries use actual post-Adam/post-clamp displacements. Fixed-event derivative norms are not exact expected hard-event loss gradients. Original and candidate clamp corrections are logged, but no separate fixed-event clamp isolation is available; their individual causal shares remain open.

retrospective_and_context_scope.interpretation: Common/content algebra is retrospective. Frozen-head response after real A/B prefixes is a local causal-history observation. Neither identifies general motor semantic sufficiency, missing information, global bottlenecks or independent post-selection performance.
